# Tender response -- JHVA-2026-TEK-014

Visakoivu Oy -- technical and property maintenance framework agreement

## Eligibility (Section 3)

3.1 NMSB 7310:2015 held, valid until 2027-06-30.

3.2 Electrical contracting rights held at class S1, exceeding the required class S2.

3.3 Valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate held.

3.4 Turnover for FY2025 was EUR 20,300,000, above the EUR 5,000,000 threshold.

3.5 62 LVI professionals employed in-house, exceeding the minimum of 20.

## Technical response (Section 4)

4.1 Scheduled HVAC visits follow a fixed annual calendar, logged on the day of each visit.

4.2 The asset register and documentation handed over at contract start will be verified and kept current.

4.3 Site personnel hold the trade qualifications and access clearances required in occupied care premises.

4.4 Lift maintenance and statutory inspection are carried out under the applicable regime, with records retained.

4.5 An occupational safety plan covering work in patient-care areas is maintained under our NMSB 75310:2018 and NOHS 61810 occupational health and safety certifications.

4.6 Building automation is confirmed compatible with BACnet and Modbus; any integration work will be scoped at handover.

4.7 Common spare parts are held in stock; parts for discontinued equipment are sourced via approved alternates.

4.8 Completed work is checked under our NMSB 7310 quality system before sign-off.

4.9 Unresolved faults escalate to a named supervisor, then to management, with the Buyer notified at each stage.

4.10 Energy-efficiency measures proposed include scheduling optimisation and controls tuning during the contract period.

4.11 Fire protection systems are tested and maintained on a defined schedule per system type.

4.12 Continuity is maintained through cross-trained cover and handover documentation if key staff change.

4.13 Proposed SLA targets are tiered by fault category, from safety-critical through to routine.

4.14 Periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations is programmed across all properties.

4.15 Commissioning and testing follow a written protocol after any equipment replacement.

4.16 Refrigeration and cooling equipment is maintained under our F-gas qualification.

## Commercial terms (Section 5)

5.3 Prices are quoted in euro.

5.5 Invoicing is monthly and available electronically in a format compatible with the Buyer's systems.

5.6 The payment terms set out in this invitation and its annexes are accepted, subject to the clarification below.

5.7 Subcontractor costs are itemised for transparency on request.

**Flagged discrepancy -- payment terms.** Section 5.8 of the main body states a payment term of 30 days net from invoice date. Liite B, Section B.3, states 14 days net for the same framework. Visakoivu Oy notes both figures and requests written clarification before signature.

## Forms enclosed (Section 6)

Reference form (Liite 2); certificate of tax payment; description of the quality system; CVs of key personnel.

## Format (Section 7)

7.1 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year.

7.3 All monetary figures are rounded to two decimal places.

7.4 Minimum font size used throughout is 11pt.

7.5 The closing time of 6 November 2026, 14:00 Finnish time, is noted.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

1.1 Subcontracted trades are selected, supervised and quality-assured under a written management plan.

2.1 A method statement is provided for installation works in occupied buildings, minimising disruption to care operations.

3.1 A preventive maintenance plan covers all system categories, with inspection intervals per category.

3.2 Proposed response times are tiered by severity, with continuous on-call cover outside normal hours.

4.1 A warranty period is offered on equipment and materials installed under the framework.

5.1 Training is provided to the Buyer's property staff on operating maintained systems, including automation controls.

6.1 Periodic inspection of the building envelope is proposed as part of the wider maintenance scope.

7.1 Our on-call arrangement, described above under Section 3.2, extends to round-the-clock cover within Finland.

## Liite B -- Kaupalliset ehdot

B.1 A bonus-malus arrangement is proposed against agreed service level targets.

B.2 Price indexation uses the standard cost-of-living index, referenced to the contract start month.

B.4 Framework pricing, including indexed adjustments, is expressed and administered in euro.

(Payment term flagged above under Section 5.)

## Liite C -- Lomakkeet

C.1 Trade register extract enclosed, dated within three months of the closing date.

C.2 Confidentiality undertaking, signed by an authorised representative.

C.3 Certificate of pension insurance payments enclosed.

Visakoivu Oy
